setup_intro: This page runs on your own server. Fill it in once; everything can be changed later.
setup_code_help: Printed on your server's console (your provider's "View console" button) after the words SETUP CODE.
password_help: At least 8 characters. It protects this page.
payout_help: A bitcoin address. Every block you find pays it directly.
pool_help: Your node builds the blocks; the pool only splits the reward.
tag_help: Written into each block you find. Letters, digits, spaces, - _ . up to 32.
syncing: Syncing. The gateway hands out work once this reaches 100%.
fs_catching_up: catching up to the newest block
fs_background: mining is on; old blocks are being verified in the background (at block %d)
fs_failed: fast start failed (%s); syncing normally instead
gateway_waiting_sync: waiting for the node to finish syncing
miner_help: Stratum URL. Worker name: anything. Password: x
saved: Saved. The gateway restarts by itself.
gateway_dashboard_help: Sign in there as user admin with this password when a page asks for it:
window_share: Your share of the next block
pool_hashrate_yours: Your hashrate as the pool sees it
not_in_window: Your address has no shares in the current window yet.
err_locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
err_address: That is not a valid bitcoin address.
err_tag: Node name: letters, digits, spaces and - _ . only, up to 32 characters.
err_write: Could not save the settings; check the server log.
cert_note: Your browser warns about this page's certificate because the server signed it itself. That is expected: choose Advanced, then continue to the site.
node_busy: The node is busy (it is loading the snapshot); this page catches up on the next refresh.
knots_running_unknown: (the node is not running; the selected build runs at the next start)
knots_switch_confirm: Switch the Knots build and restart the node now? The gateway pauses for a few minutes while the node restarts.
knots_switched: Switching to %s; the node is restarting.
snap_none: No snapshot chainstate; any build can run.
snap_active: The node started from the snapshot at height %d; background validation is still running.
snap_validated: The node started from the snapshot at height %d; validation has finished, and the next restart of the node removes the snapshot chainstate.
snap_unknown: The node started from snapshot %s, but its height could not be determined.
snap_unreachable: The node is not reachable, so its snapshot state is unknown.
knots_guard: Not available: this build does not carry the snapshot entry for height %d. A node started from a snapshot can only run builds that carry the entry until its background validation finishes and it restarts once; otherwise Knots stops with "Assumeutxo data not found for the given blockhash".
knots_guard_unknown: Not available: the node's snapshot state could not be determined, so switching is disabled to be safe.
knots_guard_unreachable: Not available: the node is not reachable; only builds that carry this image's snapshot (height %d) are offered.
update_intro: Releases are signed git tags of the image repository. The server fetches the tag, checks its signature against the release keys built into this image, builds the new system (this takes a while; the node keeps running), switches to it, and rolls back if the node is not up again within 90 seconds.
update_signout_note: This page may restart during the switch and ask you to sign in again; the update continues on the server.
releases_unavailable: Could not load the release list: %s
no_releases: No releases have been published yet.
update_tag_help: A release tag, for example v1.2.0.
update_started: Update to %s started; progress appears below.
updater_died: The updater stopped unexpectedly; see the log.
err_release_tag: That is not a valid release tag (v followed by letters, digits, . _ -).
err_guard: That build cannot run with the node's current snapshot.
session_lost: Could not read the update status (the page may have been signed out). Sign in again to keep watching.
